presentation.label: LOSSY TEMPO ECHO
presentation.summary: An echo on the tempo whose repeats pass through a lossy codec every time: darker, coarser and more broken as they fade, with packets lost and concealed.
presentation.overview: CODEC ECHO is a tempo-synced echo (1/32 to 1/2, with triplets and dotted values) on a 1.44 s line that runs at half the rate in 12 bits. Every repeat passes through the codec again: LOSS darkens it and cuts its bits (12 down to 8), and DROP loses packets of PKT's length, concealed by silence or by repeating the packet before (PLC). FDBK sets how much comes back, up to 0.95. MIX 0 returns the dry bit for bit.
highlights: Tempo-synced echo, 1/32 to 1/2 with triplets and dotted values
Each repeat darker and coarser: a low-pass and 12 down to 8 bits
Lost packets concealed by silence or a repeat
TIME and tempo changes move the echo without a click
usage: On an audio track, hold FUNC and press FX2, turn LEVEL to CODEC ECHO and press YES.
Turn MIX up on the main page; TIME picks the division, FDBK the repeats, LOSS how lossy each repeat gets, DROP and PKT the lost packets.
FX2 SETUP holds PLC: MUTE leaves a hole where a packet is lost, RPT repeats the packet before. Turn MIX to 0 for the dry.

limitations: FX2 only, and needs the Modwerk base loaded over USB (beta) with an effect id of its own; the card builds' non-stock ids are all claimed but 0x07, which the draft holds as a placeholder.
The line takes 15,870 words of the FX2 slot's buffer and stops short of Sidechain Compressor's key window. For about 0.05 s after the effect is chosen it clears the line and passes the dry.
TIME follows the tempo word octabam's BusDelay reads at r6+$13; a division longer than 1.44 s halves until it fits. Swing and track speed do not change the echo.
The echo is mono, mixed over the stereo dry. The codec is lossy on purpose: images of the half rate and the bit cut show in fx:audit (TESTING.md).
Not yet run in a built image, the ColdFire port or on a unit: only in fxhost (the vendored DSP56300 emulator alone).

storage.label: DSP program / table / buffer
storage.conditions: dsp_asm: the program words and one 12-word P table per core (TESTING.md). 32 state words in each instance's own r7 block. 15,870 words of the allocator's FX2 Y buffer per instance.

processing.label: DSP instruction peak
processing.conditions: fxhost (dsp56kEmu alone), one instance, 16-frame calls at the dearest settings: 2,517 instructions a call. Executed instructions, not chip cycles; not yet measured beside stock SPRING REV in dsp_host.

impact.conditions: One instance at its dearest settings.

cpu.rationale: No ColdFire code: a cloned effect descriptor; the stock pages publish the knobs.

dsp.rationale: About half the 314 instructions a sample octabam's benchmark reports for stock SPRING REV, in fxhost; not measured under the same benchmark.

memory.rationale: A whole FX2 slot's buffer (15,870 of 16,384 words) per instance, as stock's reverbs; a small program and a 12-word table.

tests.summary: fxhost only (the vendored dsp56kEmu with the module alone, no firmware): MIX 0 is the dry bit for bit from garbage state with trig splits; a garbage line is never heard; the echo lands within 2 samples of its division at four tempos; repeats decay with FDBK and reach digital silence; LOSS darkens; DROP leaves holes of PKT's length and RPT none; a TIME change makes no click; nothing outside the audio, state, parameter and line words is written. Not run in a built image, under the ColdFire port or on a unit.

license.declaration: Original DSP56300 code by Semi Erendönmez, GPL-3.0-or-later. No Elektron firmware, extracted routines, tables, samples or dumps are included; no stock table is read.

access.location: Audio track FX2 SETUP: CODEC ECHO in the effect chooser.
steps: Select an audio track with its TRACK key.
Hold FUNC and press FX2 to open FX2 SETUP.
Turn LEVEL to CODEC ECHO and press YES; PLC appears on the SETUP page.
Press FX2 for the main page: TIME, FDBK, LOSS, DROP, PKT and MIX.
